description: Interface definition for nullable value handling within the MigraDoc Document Object Model internals, used for managing optional or nullable properties like Color, Unit, and position values.

classes.name: INullableValue
classes.description: Interface for handling nullable values such as Color, Unit, and positional properties.

methods.name: GetValue
methods.description: Returns the stored value, which can be null.

methods.name: SetValue
methods.description: Sets the value; accepts null to represent absence of a value.

methods.name: IsNull
methods.description: Property indicating if the current value is null.
